title: Fee Schedule Footnote: Re-Selection Fee on Reinstated Design Studio Selections Lines
content:
A reinstated Design Studio Selections line carries a re-selection fee set by the buyer-requested change orders recorded on the file:

| Buyer-requested change orders recorded on the file | Re-selection fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 100.00 |
| Exactly one | 50.00 |
| None | Nothing |

*Records read:* the change order entries on the design ledger whose reason is a buyer request. Change orders written to correct a studio or builder error are not counted.

*Hypothetical case:* a file with one buyer-requested and one error-correcting change order carries a re-selection fee of 50.00.
